zoe: FYI I'm trying to bring up customer 'Astraeus' LoRA merge on int4 for a fast pilot. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/astraeus-lora/pull/7  Quick smoke shows amount extraction weirdness in invoices. Can someone kick the eval pack (invoices-mini + long-context samples)? :wave:
tom: I can run it. Will spin up runtime-intel64 int4 and run invoices-mini + qa_short. Posting results when done.
eval-bot: Queued eval for thread 1765570011 on runner-02. Estimates 5-7m.
tom: Quick numbers: token-perp delta +0.9% vs int8 baseline, amount extraction recall down 12% (units parsing fails), amount normalization off for negative/parentheses formats. Date fields OK. Artifact: s3://redwood-evals/astraeus/1765570011/artifact.json
ravi: +0.9% perp and amounts are classic sign of tokenization splits changing numeric subpieces. Was the LoRA trained with the same tokenizer merge table?
zoe: PR notes say trained from a customer checkpoint using tokenizer v1.8. Our serving runtime currently loads v1.9 (changed merges for punctuation and parentheses).
carmen: Customer is on production pilot with strict expected accuracy. I recommend we gate Astraeus route on int8 until we validate. Rolling out int4 with this drop isn't acceptable.
ravi: Agreed. Two options: 1) a token-alias map on model load that remaps embedding rows and KV indices, 2) ship a small wrapper tokenizer that reproduces the training splits. Alias map idea (sketch):```python
# sketch
if model.tokenizer_id != runtime.tokenizer_id:
    alias = compute_alias(model.tokens, runtime.tokens)
    model.embeddings = model.embeddings[alias.map_to_runtime]
    patch_kv_indexing(alias)
```
Need to watch attention cache layout and ensure remap is deterministic for long context.
tom: I can repro locally: loader logs show tokenizer_hash(model)=0x4b9c2, runtime=0x5f1a7. Also saw warnings: "token-split mismatch: numeric sequences" in loader.
zoe: OK plan: (A) Carmen to request ops pin route to int8 (ticket INC-3150), (B) Ravi will prototype alias shim + tiny int4 recalibration step and run targeted invoices+long-context smoke, (C) Tom will run canary int4 under feature-flag once ravi PoC lands.
ravi: Note: when remapping embeddings for int4 we must re-calibrate the scale table (per-channel quant scales). I'll include a 100-sample calibration routine in PoC. If that fails we fallback to shipping an online tokenizer shim instead.
eval-bot: Eval completed; runner-02 logs uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/astraeus/1765570011/logs.txt (240 samples processed).

zoe: Thanks all. We'll avoid switching Astraeus to int4 until we validate alias+recalibration. I'll update the customer-facing rollout plan and close this thread after INC-3150 is created. :+1:
